summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (imports only os and json, unannotated parameters, private helpers with leading underscores), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities automodule, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist containing the four specified tests. Extra ValueErrors beyond the spec: non-object top-level JSON, non-list key value, non-string list elements. Tests, black, and flake8 were not run per instructions; line lengths were checked with awk and all new lines are within 120 columns. Nothing committed.
